description: This file defines the Marketing model class within the Opencart platform, responsible for retrieving marketing data by code and adding marketing reports to the database.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: A model class for marketing data, including fetching marketing info by code and recording marketing reports.

methods.name: getMarketingByCode
methods.description: Retrieves marketing data based on a provided code.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Creates a new marketing report record with provided marketing ID, IP, and optional country.
